payload.text: The gate's kovacs phase gains fmt and clippy (hv, vc's decision 49 (a)): once kovacs-sysadm has added clippy and rustfmt to kovacs's stable toolchain and vc has relayed rustc -V, cargo clippy -V and rustfmt -V, kv-remote.sh's rust step runs cargo fmt --all --check and cargo clippy --all-targets --workspace -D warnings per crate, as tests.yml's clippy job does; each counts only once cargo clippy -V matches the rust job's Toolchain versions line on CI's latest run, and a mismatch is reported by name, never as a pass. Ubuntu acceptance stays unproven by name (decision 49 (b)). Size S.
